Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Robert Williams?

Robert Williams is 28 years old.

Where was Robert Williams born?

Robert Williams was born in Shreveport, Louisiana.

When was Robert Williams born?

Robert Williams was born on October 17, 1997.

How tall is Robert Williams?

Robert Williams is 6-9 (206 cm) tall.

How much does Robert Williams weigh?

Robert Williams weighs 249 lbs (112 kg).

When was Robert Williams drafted?

Robert Williams was drafted by Boston Celtics, 1st round (27th pick, 27th overall), 2018 NBA Draft.

What position does Robert Williams play?

Center.

What is Robert Williams' net worth?

Robert Williams has made at least $57,507,071 playing professional basketball.

How much does Robert Williams make?

Robert Williams made $13,285,713 in 2026.

What is Robert Williams' Instagram account?

Robert Williams is on Instagram at williams.lll.

What schools did Robert Williams attend?

Robert Williams attended North Caddo in Vivian, Louisiana and Texas A&M.

What are Robert Williams' nicknames?

Time Lord, Timelord, Boo Butt, Lob Williams are nicknames for Robert Williams.
